decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/net/downlink/a/net/downlink/cli/reply-ep, src=/sensor/temp, kind=ERROR, STATUS{ DESCRIPTION 'no such vertex', ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0020 tr::path::not_found } } } — the fwd-reply-error frame with the STATUS's optional DESCRIPTION written BEFORE the ERROR: the reader's ERROR is the first ERROR child, at whatever position, never child[0]
decoded.note: reference/05 §0x09 lists DESCRIPTION as a STATUS child and pins no order over the STATUS's children; RFC-0002 §C pins position only INSIDE the ERROR ('its first child is the identity'). A reader that demands the ERROR at child[0] reports code 0 here and loses the typed identity. Emitters stay canonical (ERROR first, as fwd-reply-error) — this vector is the acceptance rule, not a licence to emit.
